title: 第25章 聚灵阵第26章 魏武山
content_zh:
第25章聚灵阵！
“你确定要现在报名，如果我没记错的话，你来玄岳宗当杂役的时间，刚满一年不久，还有两年可以修炼的时间，你真打算现在就用掉唯一的机会？”
那姓赵外门弟子属于掌门一派的势力，所以并未因为严衡是五长老外孙的童子，而为难林浩。
他目光落在林浩身上，好心提醒道：“再说距离外门弟子考核的时间，只剩下三天，你现在报名比较吃亏，没法在那处灵气浓郁的特殊地方修炼七天。”
“赵师兄，请帮我报名。”
林浩目光坚定。
如果他还留在这里当杂役弟子，就算他打退想要欺负他的杂役，那严衡恐怕依旧不会善罢甘休。
所以成为外门弟子，就是他唯一的办法。
来到玄岳宗一年多，林浩知道宗门总共有九座主峰，除了第一峰是掌门坐镇以外，其他每座主峰有一位筑基修为的长老坐镇。
长老之间，也不是铁板一般，相互之间有亲疏矛盾。
据传，在这一年中，就有长老因为争夺天才弟子和修炼资源，争得脸红脖子粗，闹得严重的甚至直接打起来，上演斗法。
只要林浩成为玄岳宗外门弟子，选择加入与五长老关系不好的主峰，严衡就算是五长老的外孙欧阳旭的童子，也拿他没办法。
“既然你坚持，那便跟我来。”
赵师兄点了点头。
在一众其他杂役脸色阴沉不甘的目光中，林浩被带着离开矿洞了。
“这林浩以为报名参加外门弟子考核，就能躲过一劫吗？”
邹山虎嘴角浮现出一抹讥讽的笑容。
外门弟子考核，每次报名上万人，要冲进前五十，才能成功。
他不认为，一个才来宗门一年的人，可以做到。
“不过是延缓被打的时间而已。”

一名鹰钩鼻的青年，眼含杀意，冷声道：“等林浩参加外门弟子考核失败，灰溜溜的回到矿区，我一定要打得他下不了床，补气丹我拿定了。”
“以林师弟的实力，一定能通过考核成为外门弟子。”
吴峰望着林浩消失的地方，喃喃道。
他们俩关系很好，他很想帮林浩，但连他自己都是杂役弟子，想帮也无能为力。
跟着外门弟子赵师兄离开矿洞，走了不到半刻钟后。
林浩被带到一位身穿蓝袍的内门弟子面前，登记好报名信息。
“这木牌拿好，如果丢失，直接考核失败。”
那名蓝袍内门弟子语气淡漠的道。
“是，师兄。”
林浩恭敬的行了一礼，接过木牌，在外门赵师兄的指示下，林浩与其他今日刚报名的杂役弟子汇合。
大概等了一上午时间。
“走吧！
我带你们前往参加试炼的地方。”
一名内门弟子姗姗而来，取出一个小船，往地上一放，那小船瞬间变大。
这船是飞行法宝每次可载五十多人，专门用来搭载参加考核的杂役弟子。
由于距离考核只剩下三天时间，不是报名的高峰期，所以一船人，只坐了一半。
林浩一群杂役弟子，登上飞船法宝后，那名内门弟子便操纵起飞船，没过多久那飞船法宝腾空而起速度极快。
第25章聚灵阵！
下方连绵的山脉风景，在不断倒退。
content_en:
Chapter 25 Spirit Gathering Array!
"Are you sure you want to sign up now? If I remember correctly, you came to Xuanyue Sect to work as a handyman just after one year, and you still have two years left to practice. Do you really plan to use up your only opportunity now?"
The outer disciple named Zhao belonged to the leader's faction, so he did not embarrass Lin Hao because Yan Heng was the grandson of the fifth elder.
His eyes fell on Lin Hao, and he kindly reminded: "Besides, there are only three days left before the outer disciples' examination. You will be at a disadvantage if you sign up now, because you won't be able to practice in that special place with rich spiritual energy for seven days."
"Senior Brother Zhao, please help me sign up."
Lin Hao's eyes were firm.
If he still stays here as a disciple of a handyman, even if he fights off the handyman who wants to bully him, Yan Heng may still not give up.
So becoming an outer disciple was his only way.
After coming to Xuanyue Sect for more than a year, Lin Hao knew that the sect had a total of nine main peaks. Except for the first peak where the leader was in charge, each of the other main peaks had an elder who established a foundation and cultivated his power.
The elders are not monolithic, and there are conflicts between them.
It is said that during this year, some elders competed for talented disciples and cultivation resources, and the fight became so intense that they even started fighting and staged a fight.
As long as Lin Hao becomes an outer disciple of the Xuanyue Sect and chooses to join the main peak that has a bad relationship with the fifth elder, Yan Heng, even if he is the son of the fifth elder's grandson Ouyang Xu, can't do anything to him.
"If you insist, then follow me."
Senior Brother Zhao nodded.
Under the gloomy and unwilling looks of other handymen, Lin Hao was led out of the mine.
"Does Lin Hao think that he can escape disaster by signing up for the outer disciple examination?"
A sarcastic smile appeared on the corner of Zou Shanhu's mouth.
In the assessment of outer disciples, tens of thousands of people sign up each time, and they have to break into the top fifty to succeed.
He didn't think that a person who had only been in the sect for a year could do it.
"It's just delaying the time of being beaten."
A young man with a hooked nose, with murderous intent in his eyes, said in a cold voice: "When Lin Hao fails the examination as an outer disciple and returns to the mining area in despair, I will beat him until he can't get out of bed. I have decided on the Qi-Building Pill."
"With Junior Brother Lin's strength, he will definitely pass the assessment and become an outer disciple."
Wu Feng looked at the place where Lin Hao disappeared and murmured.
The two of them had a good relationship. He wanted to help Lin Hao, but even he was a handyman disciple and couldn't do anything to help him.
He followed the outer disciple, Senior Brother Zhao, out of the mine, less than half a quarter of an hour later.
Lin Hao was brought to an inner disciple wearing a blue robe and registered his registration information.
"Hold this wooden sign carefully. If you lose it, you will directly fail the assessment."
The blue-robed inner disciple said in an indifferent tone.
"Yes, senior brother."
Lin Hao bowed respectfully and took the wooden sign. Under the instructions of Senior Brother Zhao from the outer sect, Lin Hao joined the other handyman disciples who had just signed up today.
It took about a whole morning of waiting.
"Let's go!
I will take you to the place of trial. "
An inner disciple came over slowly, took out a small boat, and put it on the ground. The small boat instantly became bigger.
This ship is a flying magic weapon that can carry more than fifty people at a time. It is specially used to carry handyman disciples participating in the assessment.
Since there were only three days left before the assessment, it was not the peak period for registration, so only half of the boat was filled.
After a group of Lin Hao's handyman disciples boarded the spaceship's magic weapon, the inner disciple controlled the spacecraft. It didn't take long for the spaceship's magic weapon to rise into the sky very fast.
Chapter 25 Spirit Gathering Array!
The continuous mountain scenery below is constantly retreating.
